section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION - Differential Support Member
title: REPLACEMENT OF DIFFERENTIAL SUPPORT MEMBER CUSHION AND INSTALLATION OF DIFFERENTIAL SUPPORT MEMBER

content.text: REPLACEMENT OF DIFFERENTIAL SUPPORT MEMBER CUSHION

items.heading: REMOVE CUSHION
items.text: Using a press, press out the cushion from the support member.

content.description: Press removing cushion from differential support member using a press tool

items.heading: INSTALL NEW CUSHION
items.text: Using a press, press the new cushion into the support member.

content.text: Assemble the cushion with the recesses at right angle to the support member.

content.description: Installation diagram showing cushion orientation with rear and front markings, includes circular detail view showing recess alignment

items.heading: CHECK DIFFERENTIAL SUPPORT MEMBER
items.text: If the support member is damaged or worn, replace it.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Install the support member and lower stopper with nuts.

content.description: Exploded view diagram showing assembly order of differential support member components
Installation view showing differential carrier bolt installation on rear axle assembly
